item.title: Glide Floating 18cm - 75g
item.excerpt:
A PE5 to 8 floating stick of 18 cm and 75g of weight.

Very pleasant to use when armed with a front treble hook, frantic swimming, it feels very good in the tip of the rod during the action.

Best hook setup: 3/0 or 4/0 treble in front and inline hooks bkk diablo 9/0 or same weight back.

prevItem.title: Glide Popper 22cm - 110g
prevItem.excerpt:
22 cm and 110 g of weight. It is a small mouth popper that you can retrieve with the rod high like a pencil with repeated splashes but if necessary with traditional popping action It make a deep sound and its length makes it very stable with wave and wind.

Its length makes it very stable with wave and wind. Weight and size are optimal for making many casts effortlessly despite having a very visible size and looking for tuna or even large gt.
